headline: Rotated keys can no longer kill the forge
lede: Nov 5 proved the failure mode: Jon rotated the oMLX key, the Studio tap providers kept their stale copies, and every builder and QA·Studio session died at launch for three hours — while the warden called the work stalled. Now every lane launch re-syncs the key from its single source, and the warden tells key-death apart from a stuck game.

notes.text: #1614 shipped via PR #1619: scripts/lib/keysync.mjs copies provider.omlx's key into omlxtap, omlxtapstudio and omlxtapb at every forge.sh / forge-qa.sh launch — before model routing, so the session rides the fresh key. The Mini/MBP trio keeps its own key; nothing is ever invented, erased, or logged.

The warden's stalled path now asks first: at three idle kicks it scans the slot's newest launch log for Invalid-API-key / 401 signatures. Key death prints keydead:<slot> on the pulse and files one waiting-jon note with the fix path — the game stays claimable and heals itself the moment the key is right.

New CI gate npm run keycheck: 47 laws, 9 mutants — Mini added to the sync targets, a signature removed, the guard neutralised, even a summary that leaks the key value — all die. The secrets law pins that a key value never reaches stdout, a log, the pulse or the board.
